# Quilt Plan Kit Launch Blueprint v1.0.2

**Status:** draft · **Implementation:** PROPOSED · **Kind:** existing niche · **Created:** 2026-11-10T02:50:00Z
**Source brief:** brief_quilt-plan-kit_v1-0-1 v1.0.1 (draft), `sha256:a56e25006ec9…`
**Generated by:** @forge/builder 1.0.0 (deterministic) · **Auto-launch:** never

> A blueprint is a plan. Nothing in it is built, tested or live until a build stage records independent gate receipts. Launch always needs the owner's explicit approval.

## Decision from the brief

**go**: Quilt Plan Kit $8 planner and offer ladder. Strongest evidence of the three: a measured audience (9-11 million active consumers, 2025 survey), a $4.5B industry estimate, and many paid planners at $5-$19 plus patterns at about $5-$20. QPK also has the only live channel (Pinterest).

Falsifying test: If checkout is live and QPK gets 300+ sessions to the planner page in 60 days with zero sales, revisit price and offer. Owner-adjustable rule, not a forecast.

## Positioning

Quilting is a large, stable, older and well-off hobby audience that pays for patterns, planners and design tools; quilt calculators are free everywhere, so QPK's calculators are a traffic engine and the money is in planners, patterns and the KDP book.

| Segment | Priority |
|---|---|
| Dedicated hobby quilter (target) | primary |
| New quilter | secondary |
| Gift and holiday quilter | exploratory |

## Products

### Quilt Planner PDF (`prd_quilt-plan-kit_quilt-planner-pdf`)

entry tier · $8 (VERIFIED) · playbook `printable-pdf` · PROPOSED · builds on registry `prd_qpk_planner`

Format: Paid printable / PDF

Deliverables:
- **printable** (pdf): Print-tested at Letter and A4; page count and contents match the sales page; accessible type size for the audience.
- **preview-images** (png): Real page renders for the sales page (no mock-ups of pages that do not exist).

Gates: G4, G5, G6, G7, G8, G13

### Quilt Plan Kit Planner + Pattern bundle (`prd_quilt-plan-kit_planner-pattern-bundle`)

core tier · $18 (INFERRED) · playbook `bundle` · PROPOSED

Format: Printable PDF planner (large type) + one original pattern with cutting charts generated from QPK's tested maths

Must include:
- Everything in the $8 planner
- Gift-quilt deadline planner (work back from the date)
- Yardage and cutting worksheets for crib to king
- UFO tracker
- One original, tested pattern in several sizes
- Printer-friendly, large type

Must not:
- Use unlicensed imagery (QPK hero photo provenance is unrecorded, per WS4)
- Copy any designer's pattern

Deliverables:
- **bundle-manifest** (json): Lists every component (existing products and any new item built for the bundle) with file hashes; every component passes G4 on its own.
- **bundle-archive** (zip): Delivered archive equals the reviewed archive (hash match).

Gates: G4, G5, G6, G7, G8, G13

Falsifying test: After the $8 planner is buyable, fewer than 1 in 3 buyers take a bundle offer in the first 30 bundle-eligible orders: stay with the $8 planner and invest in traffic instead.

### KDP paperback (`prd_quilt-plan-kit_kdp-paperback`)

premium tier · $9.99 (INFERRED) · playbook `kdp-book` · PROPOSED · builds on registry `prd_qpk_paperback`

Format: Amazon KDP paperback

Deliverables:
- **interior** (pdf): KDP trim and bleed spec; fonts embedded.
- **cover** (pdf): Licensed or original artwork only; spine width from page count.

Gates: G4, G8, G13

## Sales framework (Promise, Pain, Proof, Plan, Picture)

**Promise (draft):** Finish more quilts with less waste and stress.
  - basis: Finish more quilts with less waste and stress. _[INFERRED, c_q_out_finish]_

**Pain:**
- Unfinished projects pile up (planners sell UFO trackers). _[VERIFIED, c_q_pain_ufo]_
- Fabric maths errors waste costly fabric. _[INFERRED, c_q_pain_math]_

**Proof:** has candidates. No testimonials, ratings, sales counts, user numbers or results until they exist and are verified.
Allowed kinds:
- Previews rendered from the real product files
- Worked example with clearly labelled sample data
- Verified facts from the brief, cited
- Customer feedback only once it exists, with permission

Verified facts the page may cite (these are not testimonials):
- Planners at $5-$19 and patterns at about $5-$20 are verified price points. _[VERIFIED, c_q_pp_e1]_

**Plan:**
1. Get the Quilt Plan Kit Planner + Pattern bundle for $18
2. Download it straight from the confirmation email
3. Start with: Everything in the $8 planner

**Picture (draft):** _needs a basis in the brief_

**Call to action:** Get the Quilt Plan Kit Planner + Pattern bundle

**Objections to answer on the page:**
- Free printable quilt planners and free calculators exist widely. _[VERIFIED, c_q_obj_free]_
- Buys supplies in person at local shops, so less online buying habit. _[VERIFIED, c_q_obj_shop]_

## Brand

Direction from the brief:
- Older, print-oriented audience: large type, printable pages and clear diagrams matter. _[INFERRED, c_q_vis_print]_
- Warm, craft-oriented, human imagery fits better than the current plain live design. _[INFERRED, c_q_vis_warm]_

Requirements:
- Designed for this audience, distinct from the other FORGE niches; no generic AI layout
- Licensed or original imagery only, each asset recorded in SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md
- Accessible type and contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA); readable at 320 px
- Real product previews rendered from the actual files
- Products styled to the same standard as the site that sells them

Unknown provenance is a G8 FAIL. No asset ships without source URL, author, licence, commercial-use terms and attribution recorded.

## Budget and permissions

Budget ceiling: not set (owner to set). Spend authorized: no. A ceiling is a limit, not permission to buy.

Allowed without asking:
- Local development and tests
- Generating product files and previews
- Staging preview deploys
- Draft content and copy
- Test-mode checkout once the owner has connected the account
- Writing FORGE database records for this build

Needs the owner's approval:
- Production deploy or launch
- New accounts or credential connections
- Any purchase or subscription
- Turning on live checkout
- Price changes
- Publishing outside approved campaigns
- Changes to customer data or permissions

Never:
- Fabricated testimonials, reviews, sales counts or results
- Unlicensed images, fonts or text
- Copying another designer's or competitor's work
- Spam, purchased lists or prohibited scraping
- Storing secrets in the repo or dashboard
- Writing sales rows to the ledger
- Touching businesses outside FORGE

## Done criteria

- Every required page passes its gates on a staging preview
- Every paid product passes G4 and its delivered file hash equals the reviewed file
- A test-mode purchase reaches the ledger with the right vertical, sends the delivery email, and the file opens; refund recorded
- Measurement live: beacons and sales attributed to this niche
- At least one launch channel prepared with receipts and a heartbeat-covered schedule
- All launch_readiness gates PASS with independent receipts
- Owner has explicitly approved the launch
